title: Signal sleuth: evening runbook + quick todos
content:
Purpose: quick personal evening runbook for triage shifts. Use this as my scratchpad during handoffs and quick follow-ups. Not polished; just steps, queries, and short notes to remember next run.

Context:
- Shift window: 17:30 - 22:30 PT (on-call overlap at 20:00).
- Focus: console dashboards (latency heatmap, token throughput), alerts for model-serving errors, customer-facing incidents (via support).
- Goal: reduce noisy alerts, identify real regressions, and add minimal reproducible notes for SRE/serving runtime team.

Immediate checklist (first 10 mins):
- Open: Grafana -> "console-latency-overview" panel. Quick glance for spikes last 30m.
- Query: top10 by route id where p95 > 2000ms: 
  grafana query: sum by(route) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(response_time_bucket[5m])))
- Open: Error rate board (alerts >5% sustained). Drill into latest error type (401 vs 500).
- Check Sentry / error grouping for new stacks: look for "kv-cache-mismatch" or "batcher-timeout".
- Slack: glance #console-alarms pin for ongoing incidents.

Notes from this shift:
- 18:04 -> Notice small spike on p95 for hosted/gpt-8-small in us-west-2. Root cause: sudden increase in long-sequence chat sessions from customer ACME-Co (correlates with spike in tokens-per-request).
  Action: reach out to account teammate (Rory) to confirm traffic pattern. Put temporary routing override (route policy to dedicated-queue fallback) if continues.
- 19:12 -> Repeated 502 for model-v2 on route /generate-stream (approx 0.3% of requests). Sentry shows "stream-socket-reset" grouped under connection-reset in uv connection. Possibly GRPC proxier bug.
  Quick remedial steps tried: restart proxy pod (kube svc/proxy-prod-2) -> transient drop in errors. Need long-term: escalate to infra (ticket JIRA-OPS-5421).

Customer follow-ups to record to ticket:
- ACME-Co: timestamped samples from 18:00-18:12 with request ids: r-3b4f, r-3b5a, r-3b7e. Include their prompt size and token counts. Note they used streaming + function-calls.
- RetailApp: reported images causing slow embed compute—embedding queue backlog. Collect embedding-queue length and worker restart history.

Quick queries / commands I run often (cheat-list):
- kubectl get pods -n infra | grep proxy-prod-2  # check replica status
- kubectl logs proxy-prod-2-xxxx -c proxy --since=10m | grep "connection reset" | tail -n 200
- SELECT route, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE status >=500 AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY route ORDER BY count DESC;  # PG quick check
- grafana link template: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/console-latency?from=now-30m&to=now&var-route={{route}}

Outstanding items & TODO (ranked):
- [P0] Add note to JIRA-OPS-5421 with logs & pod restart timeline (assigned to infra oncall). Due: tonight.
- [P1] Create a tiny dashboard panel that shows streaming connection resets per region (to reduce time-to-detect). Owner: me (Diego). Due: +2 days.
- [P1] Add ACME-Co token-count histogram to their customer telemetry; ask product-analytics for a short export. Owner: Rory. Due: EOD tomorrow.
- [P2] Draft doc for runbook: when to flip to "dedicated fallback" routing and how to safely roll back. Owner: me. Due: next week.
- [P3] Triage RetailApp embedding backlog with team (label: "embeddings-queue-surge"). Add to next eng-ops sync.

Observability notes / ideas (brain-dump):
- Add a small synthetic that exercises long-sequence streaming (simulate >8k tokens) and measure p95 on hosted vs dedicated; run daily at 03:00 to avoid noise.
- Consider rate-limiting heuristics by token_count rather than calls for customers who heavily stream; could reduce batcher starvation.
- Maintain a short whitelist of customers allowed to burst long sequences; flag others to auto-fallback to queued mode.

Handoff summary (if I'm handing off at 20:00):
- Current statuses: ongoing spike (ACME) trending down after routing tweak; 502 stream resets intermittent but reduced after proxy restart; no active P0 customer-facing outage.
- Immediate watch: p95 for hosted/gpt-8-small (us-west-2) for next 30m, streaming-reset alert.
- Contact: Rory Nguyen (acct) / Aisha Khan (infra oncall) / eng-sre pager if escalates.

Random scratch notes (might be useful later):
- Got a note from product that the new rollout for function-calls increases average tokens/response ~18% (could explain token inflation). Link: github.com/redwood-inference/product/PR-1202
- When writing JIRA-OPS-5421, include: exact pod names, restart timestamps, Sentry group id, representative request ids, and a minimal query to reproduce traffic filter.

End-of-shift actions (my process):
1) Fill incident ticket with timeline and evidence.
2) Post short summary in #console-alarms with clear next steps.
3) Add required follow-up tickets (dashboard panel, runbook doc) and assign.
4) Update this personal runbook with anything learned (augment cheat-list).

Notes-to-self: keep these quick. If I find myself copying large blocks repeatedly, move into a proper team doc in shared_drives/engineering/observability.
